analogy.rationale: PKC inhibitors act on a kinase family with limited expression in these cell lines and their annotated targets overlap with AKT/GSK3/MAPK signaling, so the closest reference classes are other kinase inhibitors, but the transcriptional response should be weak because PKC is not a dominant expressed pathway in these cells.
